decisions.reason: ERC-721C marketplace whitelisting changes how the existing $10 royalty is enforced, but it does not change the rule that collected secondary-sale royalties fund prize pools.
The FAQ already states that secondary sales carry a visible $10 flat royalty; the source confirms its enforcement mechanism without necessarily changing the required FAQ content.
The contract standard and secondary-marketplace whitelist do not alter the deferred Transak fiat on-ramp behavior.
Secondary-sale royalty enforcement does not change referral badge thresholds or award conditions.
The ERC-721C decision has no bearing on the deferred Discord community server.
The source concerns secondary-sale royalty enforcement and does not change the $15 primary-mint revenue allocation.
The secondary-marketplace contract standard does not change certificate actions, ebook access, or confirmation-email contents.
Using ERC-721C instead of plain ERC-721 does not change the required minted asset, which remains the novella memoir NFT ebook.
The contract-standard choice does not change use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
Royalty enforcement and marketplace whitelisting do not change automatic prize payout or winner-notification behavior.
The ERC-721C decision does not alter Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, eligible winners, or the random-selection process.
Secondary-sale royalty enforcement does not affect rewards assigned when a primary mint omits a referral code.
